# District 8 Elections

States of Jersey elections held in District 8 — St Clement — since 2022:

- **[Deputies Elections](https://flow.je/elections/district-8#deputies)**

**[St Clement Elections](https://flow.je/elections/st-clement)**

* * *

* * *

## Deputies Elections

The 2022 elections are the first to utilise the new electoral districts.

* * *

### 2022 Deputies Election

Election for the role of Deputy (3 seats), 22nd June 2022.

**[Alex Curtis](https://flow.je/elections/candidates/alex-curtis), [Barbara Ward](https://flow.je/elections/candidates/barbara-ward), [Sir Philip Bailhache](https://flow.je/elections/candidates/philip-bailhache) and [Karen Wilson](https://flow.je/elections/candidates/karen-wilson) were elected as Deputies of District 8 in 2022.**

|  | Name | Party | Votes |  |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| 1 | **[Alex Curtis](https://flow.je/elections/candidates/alex-curtis)** | Better Way | 1,485 | 59.8% |
| 2 | **[Barbara Ward](https://flow.je/elections/candidates/barbara-ward)** |  | 1,415 | 57% |
| 3 | **[Sir Philip Bailhache](https://flow.je/elections/candidates/philip-bailhache)** | Advance Jersey | 1,251 | 50.4% |
| 4 | **[Karen Wilson](https://flow.je/elections/candidates/karen-wilson)** |  | 979 | 39.4% |
| 5 | [Ken Addison](https://flow.je/elections/candidates/ken-addison) | Reform Jersey | 929 | 37.4% |
| 6 | [Lindsay Ash](https://flow.je/elections/candidates/lindsay-ash) | Jersey Alliance | 779 | 31.4% |
| 7 | [Sir Mark Boleat](https://flow.je/elections/candidates/mark-boleat) | Jersey Alliance | 721 | 29% |

2,482 ballots (inc. 8 spoilt papers)

6,173 registered voters

40.2% turnout

### 2026 Deputies Election

Election for the role of Deputy (3 seats), 7th June 2026.

- [Lindsay Ash](https://flow.je/elections/candidates/lindsay-ash) : Previous States Member \[[jerseyeveningpost.com](https://jerseyeveningpost.com/news/2026/04/12/ex-assistant-minister-hopes-to-return-to-political-fray/)\]
- [Alex Curtis](https://flow.je/elections/candidates/alex-curtis) : Current Deputy of District 8 \[[jerseyeveningpost.com](https://jerseyeveningpost.com/news/2026/04/14/st-clement-deputy-to-stand-again/)\]
- [Noah Jervis](https://flow.je/elections/candidates/noah-jervis) : New Candidate (Reform Jersey) \[[jerseyeveningpost.com](https://jerseyeveningpost.com/news/2026/04/22/ready-to-fight-for-change-youngest-reform-jersey-candidate-confirms-st-clement-bid/)\]
- [Mick Robbins](https://flow.je/elections/candidates/mick-robbins) : New Candidate (Reform Jersey) \[[jerseyeveningpost.com](https://jerseyeveningpost.com/news/2026/04/17/former-policeman-joins-election-beat-please-change/)\]
- [Joanne Vandermerwe-Mahon](https://flow.je/elections/candidates/joanne-vandermerwe-mahon) : New Candidate \[[jerseyeveningpost.com](https://jerseyeveningpost.com/news/2026/04/23/seventh-deputy-candidate-added-to-st-clement-ballot-paper/)\]
- [Barbara Ward](https://flow.je/elections/candidates/barbara-ward) : Current Deputy of District 8 \[[jerseyeveningpost.com](https://jerseyeveningpost.com/news/2026/04/01/st-clement-deputy-declares-for-election/)\]
- [Karen Wilson](https://flow.je/elections/candidates/karen-wilson) : Current Deputy of District 8 \[[jerseyeveningpost.com](https://jerseyeveningpost.com/news/2026/04/08/former-health-minister-to-stand-in-st-clement/)\]
